Be good at something besides acting be passionate about other things too…

2 days after winning his first Oscar at 31:

Conga time!  #congas #percussion #marlonbrando #Brando #actors

https://youtu.be/ZkF2-ZZSx6k?feature=shared

Trivia:  Marlon Brando

He may not have originated the “method acting” technique, but Marlon Brando was an innovator when it came to his enthusiasm for drumming. Late in life, the Oscar winner devoted his energy to developing a conga drum that could be tuned by way of a single lever at the bottom, as opposed to the usual five or six bolts along the top. Although he received four patents prior to his death in 2004, Brando likely needed to put in more work to make his creation a reality; one drum manufacturer interviewed for a 2011 NPR article indicated that the actor’s design was practical, but not cost-effective enough for production.

I am looking for a volunteer actor/actress that is interested in getting into the career.
Date: From 25th September 2026 for 3-7days depending on how quick we can get filming done (may change to later date but will let you know 2 weeks in advance)
Location: West Midlands, UK

MORE INFO:
See https://spectivestudios.co.uk/volunteer
For more info about the movie please see: https://spectivestudios.co.uk/film/zero-signal

ABOUT YOU:
I need someone confident to be on camera male or female (i have a script for both), you dont need to be an actor/actress, maybe you just want to give it a try? Maybe you just want to see if you want to start it as a career? I am willing to help people learn and establish their primary skillset in acting, I can direct you through everything each step at a time. As long as you have the time to put in effort, i have the time to film and direct.  

You will be the only actor/actress as the movie is based around 1 person (however this may change before filming depending on how many people i can get to volunteer as i have a few renditions of the script). 

Height, weight, looks, accent, hair colours....etc i dont care about, however there will be some fog involved so if you have asthma then make sure youre okay with fog before applying. 

HOW TO APPLY:
https://spectivestudios.co.uk/volunteer - Click apply next to the ad, you will be emailed a response to the email you enter.

Witam, jestem tu nowy, więc mogę mieć wiele mylnych wyobrażeń :) Chciałbym zrealizować jakiś niewielki film i mam na to przeznaczone 10 tysięcy złotych. Jeżeli tak się uda to całą kwotę mogą zabrać osoby, które wezmą w tym udział. 

Ponieważ nie proponuje wysokiej kwoty pieniędzy to nie mam nic przeciwko temu aby osoby, które były dotychczas epizodystami zagrały główne role a dotychczasowi statyści role drugoplanowe. Wszystkich ról razem w scenariuszach, które są do wyboru jest bardzo mało.

Przy okazji napiszę, że w zasadzie szukam także każdej osoby, która mogłaby pełnić jakąś inną funkcje potrzebną przy realizacji, bo zapewne zaglądają tu epizodyści i aktorzy którzy znają osoby mające pojęcie o innych funkcjach. Poza tym chętnie przeczytam wszelkie rady, bo dziedzina filmowa jest mi mało znana. Ponieważ nie proponuje wysokiego zarobku jestem gotów zgodzić się nawet na bardzo wyraźne zmiany w scenariuszu. Nie mam dużych wymagań, jako dowód, który pewnie może rozśmieszyć wiele osób :) mogę napisać, że wiele lat temu miało już dojść do realizacji takiego projektu i do filmowania miało dojść przy pomocy telefonów komórkowych a grać miały osoby mające jedynie doświadczenie jako statyści lub nie miejący nawet doświadczenia jako statyści. I zgodziłem się na takie rozwiązanie.

Może to się odbyć na terenie całego kraju z wyjątkiem Polski krańcowo wschodniej.

Co do sceniariusza, a w zasadzie scenariuszy do wyboru od bardzo krótkiego do średniej długości, zawsze główną bohaterką jest kobieta nazywana najczęściej wiedźmą. Jednak nie wiedźmą w znaczeniu strasznej i obrzydliwej kobiety, ale w znaczeniu kobiety wiedzy, wiedzy najwyższej, czyli wiedzy o ludzkiej świadomości bez której nie można wejść w stan najwyższej satysfakcji. Części te opowiadają o kolejnych żywotach/inkarnacjach tej osoby aż do ostatniej w której wchodzi ona w stan najwyższej satysfakcji/nirwanę. Tak więc wielokrotnie umiera ona i odradza się. Pomimo dużej ilości treści o tematyce szeroko rozumianej duchowości, mogących sprawiać wrażenie nieco nawiedzonych, opowiadania/scenariusze przepełnione są również dużą ilością fragmentów akcji, sensacyjnych, fantastycznych i kryminalnych. Kobieta często walczy, ucieka, goni, nie uważa przestrzegania przepisów za rzeczy najważniejsze. Jednak zawsze jest idealistką, choć czasami kontrowersyjną idealistką.

Na mojej facebook-owej stronie są po kolei wszystkie scenariusze/opowiadania w formie pisemnej ( oraz większość w formie audiobooków) do wyboru ale to duży materiał. Dlatego niemal na samym początku umieściłem krótkie streszczenie wszystkich pokolei, ponieważ są one kontynuacją kolejnych żyć bohaterki. Jeżeli kogoś zainteresuje konkretny scenariusz/opowiadanie to mogę napisać o nim coś więcej. Jeżeli ktoś zdecyduje się coś tam przeczytać albo posłuchać to proszę nie przerażać się jakością treści i audiobooków, ponieważ należy je traktować jako drafty i coś co ma ułatwić zapoznanie się z materiałem a nie rzeczy gotowe.

Z uwagi na moją niewiedzę filmową może być trochę śmiesznie :) ale mam nadzieję, że znajde osoby z którymi zrobię coś ciekawego i dzięki temu zdecyduje się w przyszłości na wykonanie kolejnego scenariusza bez zadawania śmiesznych pytań i proponowania dziwnych pomysłów :)

# **[KRAKÓW] PROWADZĄCA / WSPÓŁAUTORKA PODCASTU WIDEO**
## **Tworzę w Krakowie profesjonalny, kobiecy kanał podcastowy (gdzie pod wspólnym, silnym szyldem funkcjonują różne autorskie pasma). Zamiast budować małe kanały od zera, łączymy siły, krzyżujemy widownie i rośniemy wielokrotnie szybciej.**

Szukam do tego projektu współtwórczyń, które chcą poprowadzić swój własny, niezależny format.

Jak wygląda nasz podział ról?
* Twoja działka: Jesteś jedyną twarzą, głosem i szefową swojego formatu. Dostajesz własną playlistę. Wchodzisz do studia i skupiasz się wyłącznie na rozmowie. Zapraszasz gości, dzielisz się wiedzą i budujesz swoją markę osobistą.
* Moja działka (Produkcja i Technologia): Pełnię rolę Twojego producenta i realizatora. Zdejmuję z Ciebie 100% technicznego stresu. Dysponuje studiem wideo (wielokamerowy system na pełnoklatkowych aparatach Lumix, miksery ATEM). Ogarniam też przygotowanie krótkich form (Shorts, Reels) do promocji.

***Model biznesowy (Zasady 50/50):***

Nie płacisz mi za wynajem studia ani za sprzęt. Budujemy wspólne przedsięwzięcie i dzielimy się zyskami wygenerowanymi bezpośrednio przez Twoje odcinki (przychody z YouTube, kontrakty sponsorskie w Twoim formacie, lokowania) dokładnie po połowie (50/50). Ty masz program bez wkładu finansowego, ja inwestuję swój sprzęt i wiedzę w nasz wspólny sukces.

Żeby sprawdzić nasze biznesowe dopasowanie przed kamerą, współpracę zaczniemy od krótkiego sezonu pilotażowego.

***CZEGO WYMAGAM NA START (Przeczytaj uważnie):***

Zależy mi na kobietach, które podchodzą do swoich pomysłów z pełnym profesjonalizmem. Jeśli widzisz w tym potencjał, wyślij mi wiadomość prywatną. Oczekuję maksymalnego konkretu. Twoja aplikacja musi opisywać:
* Format i tematykę: Jaki dokładnie podcast chcesz prowadzić i do kogo ma trafiać? (Ważna uwaga: dbając o bezpieczeństwo i profesjonalizm kanału, omijamy tematy mocno polaryzujące, takie jak ostra polityka, skrajne wojny płci, internetowe dramy czy niesprawdzona pseudonauka).
* Twarde kompetencje: Dlaczego to właśnie Ty powinnaś o tym mówić? Wymagam jasnego potwierdzenia Twojej wiedzy (wykształcenie, doświadczenie zawodowe, zrealizowane projekty lub biznes).
* Bazę gości: Czy masz własną sieć kontaktów (znajomych, współpracowników, ekspertów), których od razu będziesz w stanie zaprosić do udziału w swoim programie?

Połączmy Twoją wiedzę z moją produkcją. Stwórzmy razem miejsce, gdzie dobre, kobiece rozmowy dostaną zasięgi, na jakie zasługują. Czekam na Twoją wiadomość.

items.text:
K.A. Global Pictures is casting for an upcoming British Feature Television Drama Series currently in development.

We are seeking experienced Male Actors with strong dramatic ability and, ideally, some action or physical performance experience for the following roles:

- 2 x Hard Men
- 1 Corrupt Police Officer (Plain Clothes) 

Due to the confidential nature of the project, further production details will only be disclosed to shortlisted applicants.

This production is being developed by an Award-Winning Writer & Director following the success of a critically praised theatre production that received outstanding audience and industry feedback. The project is now being adapted for the screen and has generated early interest from major broadcasters and streaming platforms.

Inspired by True Events spanning the 1980s through to the present day, this British crime drama blends realism, grit and suspense in the style of Snatch, Gangs of London, The Gentlemen, Essex Boys, Rise of the Footsoldier, This Is Our City, Mobland and Layer Cake.

Genre: Drama | Crime | Thriller

Who We're Looking For?

* British White/Caucasian Male Actors
* Late 30s, 40s and 50s
* London-based applicants preferred
* Previous acting experience essential
* Action or physical performance experience desirable

We're particularly interested in performers who can authentically portray tough, streetwise British characters with confidence and realism. Familiarity with Cockney culture, London "geezer" personalities, British popular culture and the criminal underworld portrayed in classic British dramas is advantageous. Think along the lines of iconic characters such as Phil Mitchell and Grant Mitchell.

Audition Process?

Auditions will be conducted via self-tape.

Successful applicants will progress through the following stages:

* Application review
* Casting interview
* Self-tape audition
* Character discussions and project briefing
* Final casting decisions

Shortlisted actors will also be invited to attend professional character development workshops and rehearsal sessions at our Camden, North London production hub.

Rehearsals & Character Development?

Successful applicants will benefit from:

* Professional character development workshops
* Sessions with experienced acting coaches
* Opportunities to perform in front of visiting industry professionals and talent representatives
* Rehearsals based at our Camden, London hub
* Refreshments and facilities provided
* Full rehearsal schedules issued in advance

Availability?

Applicants should have reasonable flexibility throughout rehearsals and filming. You will not be required every day; however, availability for scheduled rehearsals and production dates is essential.

Filming is expected to take place across London, other parts of the United Kingdom, and potentially overseas.

Compensation?

This is a start-up production currently in development. Production funding and performer contracts will commence once financing and production partnerships have been finalised.

How to Apply?

Please email or DM your application including:

* Headshot
* Full Name
* Telephone Number
* Acting CV, Portfolio, Showreel, Spotlight profile or other professional credentials (where available)

Email: Ahmedsy_jaber@hotmail.com

Serious Applicants Only!

We are moving quickly with this project and are looking for committed, reliable and professional actors who are genuinely interested in becoming part of a long-term television production.

If you know someone who would be suitable, please share this casting opportunity.

Here is Links attached to this post with info of what we are about -

Hey friends!! Come bash with us!!!

You might be asking, who is this party for? It's for you!!! 

This (and all CFVA events) are for all prodution artists as well as the community at large! Yes, people who are involved in screen, stage, film, television, commercial, industrial, immersive, podcast, web, vertical, music, comedy, improv, dance - all cast and crew from PA to EP from background talent to principal players - but also anyone who has ever been curious about the media and preforming arts in Colorado! We welcome everyone! 

CFVA SUMMER BASH

Join us for the CFVA Summer Bash, Colorado's can't-miss summer networking event for the film, television, video, and digital media community! Whether you're behind the camera, in front of it, or making the magic happen behind the scenes, this is your chance to connect with fellow creatives in a fun, relaxed setting. Come connect with the community, listen and bop to the sounds of our amazing DJ Tom Giesen! Enjoy the delicious fare of our incredible food trucks: Smoke Ring Romantics BBQ (there will be vegetarian options!), Sassy Sips Dirty Sodas and Jay's Philadelphia Wooder Ice!!! 

Sunday, August 2, 2026

4:00 p.m.

Buntport Theater Company

Denver, CO 80204

WHY ATTEND?

Expand Your Network

Meet filmmakers, producers, directors, editors, writers, actors, agents, crew members, content creators, and industry professionals from across Colorado.

Discover New Collaborations

Whether you're looking for your next project, your next client, or your next creative partner, Summer Bash is the perfect place to start the conversation.

Strengthen the Colorado Film Community

Build meaningful relationships, share ideas, and help grow a stronger, more connected production community throughout the state.

Celebrate the Industry

Take a break from production schedules and enjoy an afternoon with the people who make Colorado's production industry thrive.

Accessibility

This venue is ADA accessible. If you have an accommodation need, please reach out to CFVA's Disability Integration Coordinator, Shirl Garcia. 

Need help with your ticket? We want everyone to join! Just reach out to us at admin@cfva.com for a coupon code.

EVENT HIGHLIGHTS

Free Admission for Members, $10 for guests! 

Are you with the Colorado Theater Guild? Reach out to admin@cfva.com for a code to access free admission. We're bridging the gap between screen and stage artists!

Food Trucks On Site – Grab dinner or a snack from a selection of local food trucks offering a variety of delicious options for purchase.

Indoor/outdoor Venue – Stay cool and comfortable inside the unique Buntport Theater or hang outside and engage in shenanigans

Networking & Community – Make new connections, reconnect with familiar faces, and celebrate Colorado's vibrant film and media industry.

Whether you're a longtime CFVA member, new to the industry, or simply curious about Colorado's creative community, the CFVA Summer Bash is a welcoming opportunity to meet new people, exchange ideas, and build relationships that can lead to future collaborations.

Register today and join us on August 2 for an afternoon of community, conversation, and connection. We can't wait to see you at the Summer Bash!

Address 717 Lipan St Denver CO 80204

Sun Aug 2 2026, 4:00pm - 7:00pm MDT

**CASTING EXTRAS:  **

We're casting speaking roles and background extras for a DMV comedy shoot. If you love playing larger-than-life characters, this one's for you.

**DENVER DMV** is set inside the most delightfully dysfunctional government office in Denver, Colorado.Filmed in the spirit of “The Office” and “Parks & Recreation”, the series follows a quirky cast scrambling to save their jobs as their branch faces shutdown. 

**FILMING INFO:**

**Saturday 8/1:**  Time TBD but it will be a 3 hour window and maybe less.

**Compensation:**  non paid

**Location: ** Near downtown Denver

**Submissions due by:**  Wed. 7/29 EOD

**Production Company:**  Neato Pictures

**SEND SUBMISSIONS TO: ** **[martinalmaio@gmail.com](mailto:martinalmaio@gmail.com)**** and brandy@neatopictures.com**

****Be sure to include your name, phone number, email and availability on 8/1

**SPEAKING ROLES: ***(Please submit photo and video audition)*

***The Shirtless Renewal Guy (M, 20s-30s)*** — Just wants his new license photo to really capture his best self. Confidence: 100%. Shirt: optional (in his mind).

***Distracted Mom (F, 20s-30s)*** — Rambunctious young son  in tow, phone in hand, mom is anywhere but here. Bonus points if you can ignore chaos with total conviction.

***Rambunctious Young Son (M, 3-6)***** **— Toy hammer, zero chill, and a personal mission to bop every stranger in line.

***The Fed-Up Customer (F, 30s-50s)*** — Been waiting forever, gotten nothing but attitude, and is done being polite about it. Spicy, sharp-tongued, no patience left to give.

***The Vanity Plate Customer (F, 20s-40s)*** — Just wants her perfect vanity plate and cannot fathom why the DMV is making this so hard.

***The Cool Customer (M, 19-30)***** **— Charming, a little sly, and very confident he can talk the clerk into approving a plate that should absolutely not be approved.

**Background Extras** (photo submission only)

Everyday DMV customers: the patient ones, the annoyed ones, the ones glued to their phones, and the ones who make you wonder "what's their story?" We want real faces and real energy.

items.text:
Voice Over Artists Wanted – Join PureDigital Audio
PureDigital Audio is looking for talented freelance voice over artists to join our growing roster.

We're a small, independent audio production company producing professional radio adverts for local stations across the UK. While we're a new business, our team has years of experience in commercial audio production and has already created campaigns for established radio networks. We believe in building long-term relationships with both our clients and our talent.

Unlike many larger agencies, we keep our roster intentionally small. This gives every artist a genuine opportunity to be considered for work rather than becoming one of hundreds of voices on a database.

What we offer

- Fair, negotiable rates based on the project.

- A session fee for every booking.

- A commercial usage licence for the agreed campaign.

- Additional usage fees if a campaign is renewed or extended beyond the original licence period.

- Prompt payment following completion of each project.

We already have clients ready to commission work, so we expect regular opportunities. However, we can't guarantee bookings, as every client chooses the voice that best suits their brand and advert.

What we're looking for

- Professional and reliable voice over artists.

- A good-quality home recording setup.

- Clear audio with minimal background noise.

- Good communication and reasonable availability.

Please include the following with your application:

- Your voice demo or showreel.

- An audio CV or relevant experience (if available).

- Your availability.

- Details of your recording equipment, including the microphone you use.

- Your standard rates.

If you don't currently have a suitable microphone, don't let that stop you from applying. In some cases, we may be able to recommend equipment or provide a microphone on loan to UK-based artists. Any loaned equipment remains the property of PureDigital Audio and must be returned when your agreement ends.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an online group introduction where we'll explain how we work, answer any questions and discuss the next steps.

Successful applicants will also be asked to record a short demonstration piece for our website and client presentations. This demo is unpaid, as it's created solely for future marketing purposes rather than a live client campaign. You're welcome to use it in your own personal portfolio, but it must not be featured within another agency's portfolio.

All successful artists will receive a freelance agreement before any work begins. Commercials recorded for clients must remain confidential and cannot be added to public showreels or portfolios until the agreed usage period has ended or written permission has been given.

If you're passionate about creating great commercial audio and would like to work with a friendly, growing production company, we'd love to hear from you.

Seeking Agency/Casting Recommendations for 7yo (NC-based, Nationwide Travel Ready)

Hi everyone! I'm looking for advice and recommendations on potential agency representation or casting opportunities for my 7-year-old daughter.

We are navigating the industry for the first time and would love any insights! She has natural talent, great comedic timing, and is super expressive on camera.

**Details:**
* **Age:** 7 (Entering 2nd grade)
* **Home Base:** Raleigh / Cary / Apex, NC area
* **Travel Capabilities:** Open to traveling anywhere in the U.S. for the right opportunities (US travel ready).

topComments.text: Please please please be careful with finding the right agency and sharing photos of your baby online ! ❤️‍🩹 I would say tip #1 is to get some good headshots done, just look them up in your area, I would say start commercial and look up a commercial headshot photographer, if they don’t do children then they can direct you to someone who does. Maybe even from there they can direct you to some agencies you can apply for with those headshots! Best of luck and be so careful out here! 🙏

🖤 brunetem,

🧔 masz zarost,

**CASTING CALL - SHORT FILM "FAMILY TIME"**

**Union Status:** UBCP, ULB Under 40 Agreement– Union and Non-Union actors both welcome
**Production Companies:** Wanda Films & Gooseberry Films
**Writer/Director:** Rachelle Younie
**Producer(s):** Rachelle Younie, Maddy Ginn, Kenton Duncan** **

**Synopsis: **At a family reunion hosted by Cathy and Greg in their isolated mountain home, their daughter Phoebe joins cousins Marcus and Darcy and their partners Tara and Simon. When Greg, Marcus, and Simon venture up the mountain with the family dog, Phoebe becomes convinced tragedy is imminent, haunted by the unresolved death of her brother. Hours later, Ruby returns covered in blood, followed by Marcus and Simon carrying Greg's wounded body. As her family collapses in horror, Phoebe experiences an unsettling sense of relief– the catastrophe she feared has finally arrived.

**Shooting Location:** Grand Forks, British Columbia
**Shooting Dates:** September 12-14, 2026
**Audition Format:** Initials via self-tape only, followed by in-person callback
**Self-Tape Submission Deadline: **Friday, August 7, 2026
**In-Person Callbacks:** Monday, August 10, 2026
**Callback Location: **151 West Cordova Street, Vancouver, BC

**Compensation:**
* Rate: $100/day
* All meals provided
* Transportation: Carpool or Gas Reimbursement
* Accommodation: Hotel 
* IMDB credit, demo reel material

**Characters:**
GREG - Man, 55-65, Caucasian, Supporting: Greg is the husband of Cathy and the father of Phoebe. He has little to say to any of his family, feeling like he’s never really known how to be a dad or a member of a functioning family. The reunion ends tragically for Greg.

TARA - Woman, 30-40, Any Ethnicity, Supporting: A reluctant attendee of the reunion, Tara is the new fiancée of Marcus, whose extended family is having the reunion. She only knows parts of the family’s past tragedy, and finds it all very uncomfortable.

**Submission Instructions: **Please submit your resume and headshot as a single PDF document, a link to your demo reel (if applicable), your contact information, and your agent's info (if applicable) to brendan@sadsackcinema.com and indicate which role you're interested in auditioning for. Please label your email subject line: FAMILY TIME – CHARACTER NAME – ACTOR NAME. You will receive an email back with self-tape instructions and sides. Self-tapes due August 7.

We are now casting  for our touring   Autumn show Viva Las Vegas  .

The show is a musical  show featuring songs  of Sinatra, Judy Garland , Doris Day. Fred Astaire And Ginger Rogers  as well; as songs from Top Hat,  Easter Parade, The Wizard Of Oz   Calamity Jane and more.

We are looking for an experienced hardworking M/F  performer who are keen to take quality musical shows to the community  based   venues .

The show is a one man/woman show so we are looking for experienced performers that can hold an audience and are looking for engaging vocalist performers.

Rehearsals- 24th -28th August  

Playing Dates- 31st  August  -30th October .

We work Monday to Friday (2 x 60 minute shows per day)

Casting Breakdown

We are offering 750 00 per week plus accommodation  and fuel on the road 

Please send details including a singing reel to info@theentertainmentproviders.co.uk

Hi everyone! 

I am casting for a range of roles for a new horror film, we are looking for people based around Colchester, Essex. 

We will be shooting the week commencing the 10th of August - 16th August so please only apply if you have good availability for this time. 

Harper (lead character) 
- needed for three shooting days 
- Age range 19 - 25
- Female character
- Has to be okay with SFX makeup 

Producer character 
- needed for one shooting day 
- Age range 25 - 40+
- Female character

Laura (side character) 
- needed for one shooting day 
- Age range 19 - 25
- Female character 

Unfortunately this is an unpaid project, so please only apply if you are interested in showreel footage/experience!! 

Please email sophiebrock3@hotmail.com if you are interested! thanks

items.text:
CASTING CALL: SHORT FILM 🎬
Project: Mosdak (Psychological Thriller Short Film)

Location: Chicago Area Office Location

Shoot Dates: Thursday, August 20th & Friday, August 21st, 2026

Time Commitment: 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Both Days)

​LOOKING FOR:

[CLARA] – Female, 20s–30s. Sharp, high-strung, polished professional who undergoes a dark, hypnotic psychological transformation. Requires strong non-verbal acting and the ability to project an intense, vacant trance state on camera.

​Role of Mosdak is already cast.

​COMPENSATION & PERKS:

​Film Credit (IMDb / On-Screen Credit)

​Copy of finished film for reel

​Catered lunch provided (Pizza! 🍕)

​HOW TO APPLY:

Please send your headshot, reel/resume, and a short video reading the following line:

​CLARA: (Sighs, relaxing a fraction) "It’s like I can’t turn it off. My last therapist just gave me breathing exercises. They didn't work."

​Send applications via DM or email: sarahweiss2889@gmail.com with the subject line: "Mosdak Casting - Clara".

​Feel free to share or tag anyone who might be a great fit!

🚨 **URGENT CASTING CALL: JHB & CPT INFLUENCERS / CREATORS** 🚨

Off The Ramp is sourcing local content creators for an exciting **"Come Shop With Me" Reel** campaign celebrating the launch of **SuperDry & Co’s** brand-new store openings! 🛍️✨

We are looking for fashion, lifestyle, and streetwear creators based in **Johannesburg** and **Cape Town** who bring great energy on camera and produce clean, high-quality video content.

📅 **Store Opening Dates:**
* **Johannesburg (JHB):** 1 August 2026 *(Urgent - Applications closing immediately!) *Shooting time expected is one week from the store opening 
* **Cape Town (CPT):** 6 August & 9 August 2026. Shooting time expected is one week from the store opening 

**Requirements:**
* Based in **Johannesburg (JHB)** or **Cape Town (CPT)**
* Experience creating engaging, short-form "Come Shop With Me"
* Strong on-camera presence
* 👉 **How to Apply:**
1. **Sign Up:** Create your free account on https://offtheramp.co.za/talent-crew-creatives-tcc/
2. **Build Your Portfolio:** Create a Content Creator Listing / Portfolio on your profile.
3. **Get Pitched:** We will present your Content Creator Listing / Portfolio directly to the client for selection!

Casting Call: Male Actor Needed for Social Media Content
We’re looking for a male actor (ages 26–45) to portray a dentist in a series of social media videos for two dental offices.

Location: Brentwood, CA & Newbury Park, CA

Tentative Shoot Dates: August 3, August 5, August 10, and August 12

Rate: $70/hour

Shoot Length: 2–3 hours

Travel: Gas reimbursement provided

About the Role

You’ll be creating engaging social media content for dental practices, including:

* Speaking on camera using a teleprompter for short educational videos

* Participating in fun, TikTok-style content

* Filming candid lifestyle shots around the office

We’re Looking For Someone Who Is:

* Male, appearing 26–45 years old

* Comfortable and confident on camera

* Able to read a script naturally and conversationally

* Positive, energetic, and reliable

* Has dependable transportation

Interested?

Please DM:

* A recent headshot or photo

* A short introduction about yourself

* Any acting or on-camera experience (if applicable)

items.text:
**Brand Ambassador – Forme x Erewhon (Los Angeles)**

Forme is building a team of exceptional brand ambassadors for exclusive pop-up events at Erewhon locations across Los Angeles.

As an official partner of the **WNBPA**, **MLB Players Association**, and **Harvard Athletics**, Forme works with leading athletes, healthcare organizations, and wellness communities to help people move, feel, and recover better.

We're looking for energetic, polished, and personable individuals who naturally connect with people and represent premium brands with confidence.

As a Forme Brand Ambassador, you'll engage with customers, educate them on our products, and help create an exceptional in-person brand experience. Throughout the year, you'll also have opportunities to support activations featuring professional athletes, creators, influencers, and other notable partners representing Forme.

**We're looking for people who:**
* Have an outgoing, engaging personality
* Present themselves professionally and confidently
* Have experience with brand activations, events, retail, hospitality, or customer engagement
* Are passionate about wellness, fitness, or premium consumer brands

**Compensation:** Up to $30/hour

**To apply, email ****[hiring@forme.science](mailto:hiring@forme.science)**** with:**
* Subject: BA Application - Forme LA
* Your Instagram profile **or** a headshot
* A short video of you working an event, engaging with customers, demonstrating a product, or similar experience

**Applications without these materials will not be considered.**

🎬 CASTING CALL — CUT OFF
Strong Baby Productions | Filming Location: California | Theatrical Release: July

Warner Bros. Pictures and Strong Baby Productions are seeking talented actors for supporting roles in CUT OFF, a comedy feature written and directed by Jonah Hill. This project features an acclaimed cast including Jonah Hill, Kristen Wiig, Bette Midler, and Nathan Lane.

Project Overview:

CUT OFF follows two affluent siblings who are unexpectedly cut off from their family fortune and must navigate life independently. The film is a sharp, character-driven comedy combining satirical humor with emotional depth.

Supporting Roles Available:

    Dex Fontaine: Male, 30-55. A commanding, deadpan life coach with a hidden warmth.

    Claira Nair: Female, 25-34, South Asian. An energetic, quick-witted neighbor balancing humor and heartfelt moments.

    Todd Blumfeld: Male, 30-42. A smug former assistant with precise comedic timing.

    Grandma Ruthie: Female, 60-80. A warm yet blunt elder with strong stage presence and comic timing.

    Cleo & Marcus: Female & Male (casting as a pair), 30-50. A glamorous couple with natural chemistry, playing cheerfully oblivious socialites.

    Felipe: Male, 45-63, Latino preferred. A wise, warm bodega owner with bilingual abilities advantageous.

Submission Guidelines:

Please submit your professional headshot, résumé, reel or self-tape, contact details, and specify the role you are applying for to (gershangency00@hotmail.com) Submissions from all backgrounds and experience levels are welcome. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

We look forward to your submissions.

**COLD BLOWS THE WIND**

**Independent feature film — now casting**

Shooting in British Columbia, 15 August – 31 October 2026

Somewhere on the coast of British Columbia there is a cove. In that cove, there is a sailboat called Esperanto.

What happened there is disputed. Two old men will tell you one version, loudly, over the top of one another. A

father tells his daughter a gentler one. A woman writes it all down at night and is not certain she believes a word

of it.

There is a mermaid in it. She is several hundred years old and she likes old black-and-white movies.

We are looking for faces with weather in them and voices with some mileage. This is a character piece before it is

anything else — long scenes, real silence, and very little explaining. If that is the work you like, we would like to

see you.

**PLEASE NOTE: MIRA and LITTLE MIRA are two entirely separate characters who happen to share a**

**name. Little Mira is not a younger version of Mira and is not related to her. Please do not submit for both.**

**ROLES**

**MIRA — female, late 20s to 30s, playing ageless. Open ethnicity. LEAD.**

She is several hundred years old and mentions it about as often as anyone else mentions their age. Asked directly,

she lies — smoothly, immediately, and well.

She is not tragic and must not be played tragic. Funny, impatient, jealous, and without a shred of

self-consciousness — she dances when she wants to dance, cooks, picks fights, and is not impressed by anybody.

Charm is the surface. It is not the note.

WATER: strong, confident open-water swimmer. Surf, underwater and cold-water work. Breath-hold comfort

essential. Prosthetic tail and performance work. Freediving, monofin or professional mermaid-performance

experience is a substantial asset — but genuine ease in cold open ocean is the non-negotiable, and it is verified

before callbacks. Please do not overstate it. We would far rather know now.

NUDITY: there is no onscreen nudity. A small number of mermaid sequences are written to imply it and are

achieved entirely through framing, water and camera angle — closed set, discussed in full in advance, covered at

contract. Intimacy in the film is limited and is staged with an intimacy coordinator.

**LITTLE MIRA — female, 7 to 9, to play 8. Open ethnicity. LEAD.**

A serious, watchful, self-possessed child. She corrects adults quietly and without heat. She rations her food. She

holds a conversation with a stray dog and takes it seriously. She notices everything and reports none of it.

She is not precocious and she is not plucky. She is a small person with adult composure, doing something

enormous and telling nobody about it.

Much of the part is silent. There are long passages with no dialogue and no scene partner, where the whole of the

scene is a child thinking. That is the job.

No swimming and no water work of any kind. She should be comfortable outdoors — gravel, forest, weather, and

walking real distances.PARENTS AND GUARDIANS: we are looking for a child who is comfortable being quiet. Who goes still when

she is thinking instead of filling the silence. Who watches a room for a while before she joins it. Children like this

get called shy, or serious, or old for their age.

She does not need experience. No class, no headshot, no set. If she has never once considered acting and you are

reading this because something in it made you think of her — that is the submission we want most.

About the material: this is a drama, and loss is part of the story. The part asks for real feeling. There is nothing

frightening or graphic in it. A guardian is with her throughout, every requirement for working with a minor is

provided for, and we will go through all of it with you properly before any of it reaches her.

Maximum 8-hour days, per BC Employment Standards for performers under 12. Approximately 25–30 shooting

days, dates to be confirmed.

**ISAAK GREY — male, late 30s to 40s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**LEAD.**

A marine biologist. Sometimes. The rest of the time he disappears into the woods for a few months and comes

back broke — his own line, told as a joke, to strangers, at a dinner table.

Charming, self-deprecating, allergic to his own potential. The kind of man who is right about everything except

himself and would rather be liked than believed. He loves the water in a way he cannot make sound reasonable to

anyone.

Both versions of Isaak need to exist in the same actor already — sharp, well-dressed and sure of himself in one

timeline, holes in his shoes in the other.

The problem to solve: playing failure without apologising for it and without winking at us. He knows precisely

what he is. He simply cannot do anything about it.

A distinctive, characterful profile is an asset. A subtle prosthetic is used in one timeline; a broken nose is not a

requirement. Approx. 11 days.

**THOMAS CAINE — male, 70s to play 75. British character; authentic or exceptional British**

**accent required. LEAD.**

A prospector, a raconteur, and a magnificent bullshitter.

Much of this role is direct storytelling — spoken aloud to a listener, at length, and interrupted at every turn by his

partner of forty-odd years. He preaches, he spits, he does voices, he swears in front of children and gets told off

for it, and he is having the time of his life. Then something crosses his face, the performance drops for half a

second, and he picks it back up and carries on.

The problem to solve: holding a room with nothing but a voice, and letting us see — in one unguarded beat

between sentences — what it costs him to keep talking. This is a stage actor’s part. It wants somebody who has

done it in front of people.

Extensive V.O. as well as on-camera work, including some boat and water work. Read in pairs with WALTER at

callbacks. Approx. 9 days.

**WALTER WEIRS — male, 70s. British character; authentic or exceptional British accent**

**required. Genuinely large build. LEAD.**An enormous man with hands like catcher’s mitts and the gentlest disposition in the film. A former fighter who

spent his career ending other men’s brawls rather than starting them — most of them started by Thomas.

His job is to interrupt, correct and soften. Not for accuracy — for fairness. He loses most of these arguments and

goes on making them anyway. Forty years of partnership sit underneath every line and are never once explained.

Physically large, tall and broad, is written into the character and remarked on by others. Warmth is the essential

quality; the size is only interesting because of the care with which he uses it.

If you have spent a career being cast for your size, this is the part where it finally means something else.

Read in pairs with THOMAS at callbacks.

**DEBORAH — female, 40s to 50s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**SUPPORTING.**

A woman who confuses cynicism with wisdom. Quick, funny, socially fearless, and just cruel enough that you

flinch about half a second after you have laughed. Excellent company with a glass of white wine in her hand and

considerably harder to be around at home.

She is not a monster and cannot be played as one. She decided a long time ago that expecting less of people is the

same thing as being clever, and she is quietly handing it on.

The problem to solve: the audience has to like her before they are allowed to be disappointed in her. If they clock

her early, the part is gone.

Partnered with HELEN — read in pairs at callbacks. Established pairs are welcome to submit together.

**HELEN — female, 40s to 50s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**SUPPORTING.**

Deborah’s partner. Gentle, watchful, nurturing, and considerably tougher than she first appears — she is the one

who laughs a thing away, and also the one who knows exactly what she is laughing away.

The part is small and load-bearing. In a house with very little kindness in it she is the kindness, and she never

once makes a speech about it.

The problem to solve: most of this role is reaction. We are looking for a great listening face — an actress who is

visibly doing something specific while other people talk.

Partnered with DEBORAH — read in pairs at callbacks. Established pairs are welcome to submit together.

**COMPENSATION**

$200 CAD/day flat, all roles — leads and supporting alike. Ten-hour days, paid weekly. Non-union.

Milestone bonuses on top of your fee, tied to money actually arriving rather than paperwork being signed. On the

production’s receipt of distribution revenue, a bonus equal to one times your total engagement fee. On

recoupment of total production cash cost, a further two times. Full terms are set out in the engagement agreement.

Little Mira: maximum 8-hour days, per BC Employment Standards for performers under 12.

**LOCATIONS**Vancouver, BC (Locarno Beach, False Creek, Vancouver Harbour) · Georgia Strait · Gibsons / Desolation Sound

area, BC · BC Ferry (Langdale route). Some work is outside Vancouver. Travel and accommodation details

confirmed on casting.

**TO SUBMIT**

Headshot, resume, and reel or self-tape link to casting@horstcreative.ca

MIRA — please include a brief and candid note on your open-water and cold-water experience, and any

freediving, monofin or breath-hold background.

THOMAS and WALTER, DEBORAH and HELEN — tell us if you are submitting as an established pair.

LITTLE MIRA — parent or guardian only. Send a recent photo and a short video of her talking about something

she likes. No performance necessary. Please don’t rehearse her or prepare anything — we’d rather see her as she

is.

Sides are released to selected submissions. Full script at callback under NDA.

Self-tapes due 7 August. Callbacks 9 August. THOMAS and WALTER open until filled.

**We would rather see one honest read than three polished ones.**

🎬 CASTING CALL – “Forever, Summer” (Volunteer Short Film)

Hey everyone! ❤️

I’m so excited to share that we’ve officially started casting for my passion project, Forever, Summer, a romantic drama short film that will be filmed in Metro Vancouver this September.

We’re currently casting:

🎭 Hunter (Lead)
• Playing age: 23 (Actors 19+)
• Open to all ethnicities

🎭 Ryan (Supporting)
• Playing age: 27 (Actors 23+)
• White or Hispanic preferred, with dark hair and dark eyes to reflect a believable family resemblance.

📍 Must be able to work locally in Metro Vancouver.
📅 Must be available between September 4–7, 2026.

This is a volunteer project, and all cast members will receive:
• IMDb credit
• Professional footage for their demo reel
• Meals on set
• An invitation to attend film festival screenings if the film is officially selected

To submit, please email which character do you want to audition, your headshot, resume and demo reel (if you have one) to foreversummer.casting@gmail.com  by August 9. Selected actors will receive audition sides.

Thank you so much!!

Dara

LIVERPOOL CASTING: FEMALE PRESENTERS / STREAMERS / UGC CREATORS
📍 Our studio is based in Birkenhead

This is flexible work with the opportunity to earn great commission on days with strong sales.

We are mainly looking for women who are confident and comfortable speaking on camera. Everything else can be learned on the job 😊

Each shift is 5 hours, including a 1 hour break.

Pay: £90 + 3.2% sales commission per shift.

For example, if you generate £2,000 in sales during your shift:

£90 + (£2,000 × 3.2%) = £154 total pay

Sales typically range between £1,000 and £3,000 depending on the day, engagement and performance, meaning there is great potential to increase your earnings through commission.

Previous live-streaming experience is not required.

If you’re interested, please DM us on Instagram with:

• Your photos

• A short speaking video — this can be UGC-style content, acting footage, presenting footage, or simply a short introduction video!

Agency Instagram:  @missimmanagement

items.text:
**Mini serial  wojenny 1940 – Szukamy ojca głównej ( lat 40 – 45 )**

 

Nasza Gliwicka Grupa Pasjonatów ‘’Grupa1940’’ poszukuje mężczyzny do roli ojca głównej bohaterki. Najlepiej jakby kandydat miałby od **40 – 45 lat** o rudych włosach i bez zarostu, o określonych parametrach: **obwód w klatce 100- 105, obwód pasa 90/95 cm** i **wzrost: 175 -180** . Szukamy kogoś **z Gliwic lub okolic: Zabrze, Katowice** najdalej. Postać ta będzie nosić mundur polski podporucznika.Same zdjęcia będą realizowane na terenie Gliwic. Niestety nie zwracamy kosztów podróży. Postać mężczyzny pojawi się w pierwszym odcinku i zostanie zabita przez odział niemiecki. Pojawi się też w retrospekcji bitwy w 1919 roku z Bolszewikami gdzie zostanie ranny w nogę. Oczywiście mile widziane doświadczenie pracy z tekstem. Scenę wstępnie będziemy realizować na przełomie marca lub kwietnia.

Zdjęcia planowane są na początek października z udziałem tej postaci.

 

**Od kwietnia 2026 zaczęliśmy realizacje zdjęć do tego **projektu. Mini serial jest oparty o wątki grupy okultystycznej ’’**Ahnenerbe’**’ która chce zdobyć słynne artefakty ale w tym ktoś im chce przeszkadzać. Projekt będzie  się składać z 6 odcinków po 10/12 minut każdy. Będziemy też sukcesywnie dodawać inne ogłoszenia związane z tym projektem. Mile widziane zdjęcia aktualne. Na zdjęciu powyżej osoba będzie mieć podobny kostium.** **Umieszczone materiały są z naszej sesji.** Nie będzie to zlecenie płatne.**

 

Od 01.04.25 założyliśmy swój kanał na portalu youtube z filmami z naszych planów żeby można było zobaczyć jak to u nas wygląda od kuchni. 

 

https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61579390690805

https://www.instagram.com/lukasz.magiera.official

** **

**Nie będzie to zlecenie płatne.**

 

Więcej informacji na Priv

**Serial nie jest stworzony z sympatii do tej nazistowskiej organizacji lecz wynika to z samego scenariusza aby ukazał zbrodnie i sam fakt iż była w pełni zła. W produkcji znajdą się osoby, które będą chcieć walczyć i potępiać te wielkie zło jakim był nazizm. W oparciu o Dz.U.2017.0.2204 t.j. - Ustawa z dnia 6 czerwca 1997 r. - Kodeks karny,Art. 256 "Propagowanie faszyzmu lub innego ustroju totalitarnego lub nawoływanie domnienawiści", §3 - nie narusza prawa proponując przedmiot do celów historycznych lub kolekcjonerskich.**

items.text:
Hi! Casting last minute for tomorrow evening.

Need a doctor for an infomercial in weho!

[Man; 40 to 60 years old; White. Dr. Gideon Void is a slick, charismatic, and wildly popular local “celebrity doctor” known for his flashy late-night infomercials and over-the-top charm. With his polished yuppie aesthetic, million-dollar smile, and smooth-talking salesman energy, he’s the face of cutting-edge memory-erasure procedures. Beneath the gleaming smile and infomercial flair lies something darker — a man who genuinely believes he’s helping people… or is he? This role requires a strong commercial-style performer who can deliver a captivating 1-minute on-camera advertisement for a revolutionary (and slightly sinister) lobotomy-inspired procedure that allows patients to selectively forget painful memories — in this case, an ex-girlfriend.

Hi everyone!

I’m not sure if this is the right place to post this, so if there is a more appropriate group please let me know.

I am looking for beginner-friendly dance classes in Adelaide SA, specifically jazz, tap and/or Broadway. I have been a ‘strong mover’ for far too long! My auditions are beginning to suffer from a lack of technical know-how, so I’m turning to you all.

If anyone knows of any free/cheap classes please comment or DM me! I am, of course, doing my own research, but I thought someone may currently be enrolled in a class that meets my criteria.

Thanks for your help!

items.text:
Non-Union Casting Call for Short Film “You Are Safe Now”
“A psychological thriller where paranoia and reality become impossible to separate.”

Short Film Logline:

A vulnerable young woman becomes convinced that a group of people are stalking her. Her husband insists it’s the result of her deteriorating mental health. Is she uncovering a terrifying conspiracy—or is she losing her grip on reality?

CASTING FOR TWO LEAD ROLES!

Charlotte

Age Range: 20-30s • Female • Any Ethnicity

Charlotte is a once-promising software engineer whose worsening mental health has left her isolated and working a grocery store job. Intelligent and deeply self-aware, she struggles with growing paranoia while desperately trying to hide the extent of her condition from those around her.

⸻

Lance

Age Range: 20-30s • Male • Any Ethnicity

A successful software engineer who has reluctantly become the caretaker for his wife as her mental health deteriorates. Intelligent and dependable on the surface, Lance harbors growing resentment over the sacrifices he’s made and has begun seeking emotional connection

⸻

SUBMISSIONS

Please send your headshot, acting résumé, and demo reel (if available) to:

aidantimm@peaceofmindpictures.com

Selected applicants will be contacted with audition details.

⸻

SHOOT DETAILS

Type of Project: Psychological Thriller Short Film (Approx. 5 minutes)

Location: Vancouver, BC

Shoot Dates: August 21–23, 2026

Compensation: Unpaid (Passion Project) • IMDb Credit • Meals Provided

⸻

HOW TO SUBMIT

Please email your headshot, résumé, and demo reel (if available) to:

aidantimm@peaceofmindpictures.com

Applicants must be available August 21–23, 2026.

Hello All!

I'm looking to cast the roles of April and June for a play that will be featured in HERFest UK 2026, a festival of new Writing celebrating female writers and creatives, along with a strong female lead.

'The Days Between Spring and Summer' has been written by the incredible Elinor Boult, who won this year's Homotopia prize for New Writing with this very play... now we want to bring it to life in its full HD glory!

Please pass this link on to anyone you feel may be a good fit for the role and be interested.  

You can apply directly on Monday using the link below, or if you want to, please feel free to message me and I can give you further details or check out the HERFest UK page and website: herfest.uk

Betreff: Suche nach einer Wochenend-Camera-Acting-Ausbildung
Hallo,

ich suche im Raum Baden-Württemberg eine 3-monatige Camera-Acting-Ausbildung oder einen Screen-Acting-Workshop, der nur samstags und sonntags stattfindet.

Ich arbeite derzeit im Zwei-Schicht-Betrieb, deshalb kann ich nur am Wochenende teilnehmen.

Mein Budget beträgt bis 350 €.

Ich bin Anfänger und suche einen Kurs für Anfänger als Hobby, um die Grundlagen des Camera Actings zu lernen und erste Erfahrungen vor der Kamera zu sammeln.

Falls Sie einen passenden Kurs anbieten, freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Nachricht.

Vielen Dank!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Rembo Lakatos

**CASTING CALL:**

Hello everyone!

I'm currently casting **Solitaire**, an upcoming independent short film shooting in the GTA this August, and we're looking for talented actors to join our cast.

**Project:** *Solitaire* (Short Film)
**Location:** Greater Toronto Area
**Shoot Dates:** August 17–18 & August 24–25, with a scheduled pick-up day on August 27.
* NON UNION/ NON PAID
* Food and beverages will be provided

If you're interested, you can:
* Apply through our Backstage casting notice:
https://www.backstage.com/casting/solitaire-3199900/

**OR** email your submission directly to **damirshahi@gmail.com** with:
* Headshot
* Resume
* Demo reel (if available)

**ROLE:**

NEIL

GENDER: MALE

AGE: 40-60

A middle-aged (late 40s, early 50s) man who believes he is still a 17-year-old high school student serving detention in 1990. Neil creates an imaginary life for himself in detention, and is kept company by a sock puppet friend, Mikey, whom Neil voices. items.previewDescription: Casting "Solitaire," a short film about a middle-aged man who is stuck in high school detention because he didn’t realize he could’ve left years ago.
items.title: Short Film: 'Solitaire' | Backstage
items.summary:
**CASTING CALL:**

Hello everyone!

I'm currently casting **Solitaire**, an upcoming independent short film shooting in the GTA this August, and we're looking for talented actors to join our cast.

**Project:** *Solitaire* (Short Film)
**Location:** Greater Toronto Area
**Shoot Dates:** August 17–18 & August 24–25, with a scheduled pick-up day on August 27.
* NON UNION/ NON PAID
* Food and beverages will be provided

If you're interested, you can:
* Apply through our Backstage casting notice:
https://www.backstage.com/casting/solitaire-3199900/

**OR** email your submission directly to **damirshahi@gmail.com** with:
* Headshot
* Resume
* Demo reel (if available)

**ROLE:**

NEIL

GENDER: MALE

AGE: 40-60

A middle-aged (late 40s, early 50s) man who believes he is still a 17-year-old high school student serving detention in 1990. Neil creates an imaginary life for himself in detention, and is kept company by a sock puppet friend, Mikey, whom Neil voices. Neil is easily impressionable, cocky, immature, and not the sharpest tool in the shed.

Thank you, and I look forward to seeing your submissions!

items.text:
Hello, I'm Nicole my son Nathan Golding, is an aspiring film director with a passion for cinema.

He is currently working on a short horror film that will be filmed in Luton, in Popes Meadow. This isn't for a big agency or anything, It is a small independent project with one camera, a few props, and a runtime of approximately 4–6 minutes. As this is an independent student-style production, this is unpaid, but cast members will receive full screen credit.

He is looking for two actors aged 18–19 to take part: one female actor and one male actor. The characters he's written have specific appearances that fit the story’s vision, including a blonde-haired female character and an Asian male character.

The title of this film is called Silent voice and it's about a young woman who enters a forest with an old school acquaintance, but their peaceful walk turns unsettling when she begins hearing a mysterious voice calling her name. Throughout her journey, she experiences terrifying events that make her question what is real and what is not.

Attached below is the link to his Instagram page. If any actors are interested in taking part, in the project, or has any questions, please contact him  directly through

 Instagram.

The title of this film is called Silent voice and it's about a young woman who enters a forest with an old school acquaintance, but their peaceful walk turns unsettling when she begins hearing a mysterious voice calling her name. Throughout her journey, she experiences terrifying events that make her question what is real and what is not.

Attached below is the link to his Instagram page. If any actors are interested in taking part, in the project, or has any questions, please contact him  directly through

 Instagram.

Hello everyone! My name is Connie, and I’m based in Temecula, California, originally from Los Angeles.

I was a plus-size model in the late ’90s and early 2000s, and modeling has always been a passion close to my heart. In 2021, my life took an unexpected turn when I was diagnosed with breast cancer. That journey changed me in many ways, but it never took away my love for creating, storytelling, and being in front of the camera.

Today, I’m grateful to be rebuilding my life and stepping back into the world I love. I’m available for modeling, acting, lifestyle, commercial, creative, and collaborative content. I’m located near San Diego and about two hours from Los Angeles, and I’m happy to travel for the right opportunity.

If you’re a photographer, creative, brand, or filmmaker looking to collaborate, I’d love to connect. You can reach me on Instagram.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. Here’s to new beginnings, beautiful collaborations, and doing what makes our souls come alive.

Sending love and light to everyone. 🖤✨

https://www.instagram.com/mrs_conniehjarvis?igsh=NTc4MTIwNjQ2YQ%3D%3D&utm_source=qr

items.text:
AFFÄRE ODER BEZIEHUNG? EIN DATE, DAS PLÖTZLICH KIPPT

Zwei Darsteller. Drei Locations. Keine vorgegebenen Antworten.

Was passiert, wenn ein scheinbar entspanntes Date plötzlich eine Richtung nimmt, mit der einer von beiden nicht gerechnet hat?

Mira Tzenov und Christian Weiße treffen in einer improvisierten Filmszene aufeinander. Ausgangspunkt ist ein gemeinsames Date in der L'Osteria Köln Zollhafen. Doch irgendwann fällt der entscheidende Satz: Einer von beiden will keine monogame Beziehung, sondern nur eine Affäre.

Improvisation statt auswendig gelernter Dialoge

Wie reagiert das Gegenüber? Enttäuschung, Verständnis, Wut oder vielleicht sogar Zustimmung? Genau das entsteht spontan vor der Kamera.

Gedreht wurde an drei markanten Orten im Kölner Rheinauhafen: in der L'Osteria Köln Zollhafen, vor dem Schokoladenmuseum und am Kölner Riesenrad. Das Riesenrad steht aktuell direkt am Schokoladenmuseum.

Das vollständige Video mit Mira Tzenov und Christian Weiße erscheint bald. Folge uns und entscheide selbst: Affäre oder Beziehung, wie würdest Du reagieren?

#Schauspiel #Improvisation #Darsteller #Köln #Filmproduktion

sharedPost.text:
Glosse: Nur fünfzehn Jahre Verspätung

Fünfzehn Jahre. So lange hat es gedauert, bis eine Frau ihre Würde ein Stück weit zurückbekommen hat.

Das ist doch eigentlich eine beeindruckende Leistung – allerdings nicht für die Gerechtigkeit, sondern für deren Schneckentempo. Während andere in fünfzehn Jahren eine Ausbildung machen, Karriere aufbauen, Kinder großziehen oder in Rente gehen, brauchte die Filmwelt dieselbe Zeit, um zu erkennen: Vielleicht sollte man eine Szene mit einer 13-Jährigen, die halbnackt im Bett liegt und von einem Erwachsenen berührt und geschlagen wird, doch nicht einfach stehen lassen.

Man fragt sich unweigerlich: Musste darüber wirklich anderthalb Jahrzehnte nachgedacht werden? Wurde die Filmszene jedes Jahr erneut in einem Gremium begutachtet? Gab es Protokolle mit dem Tagesordnungspunkt: „Würde – vertagt auf nächstes Jahr“?

Wim Wenders hat die Szene nun entfernt. Das ist richtig. Aber wenn eine Einsicht fünfzehn Jahre Anlauf braucht, wirkt sie weniger wie ein mutiger Schritt als wie ein sehr verspäteter Anschlusszug.

Immerhin zeigt der Fall: Würde hat kein Verfallsdatum. Sie kann ignoriert, verdrängt oder kleingeredet werden – verloren geht sie dadurch nicht. Und manchmal dauert es eben fünfzehn Jahre, bis jemand begreift, dass Respekt keine Frage der Regie, sondern des Anstands ist.

Die eigentliche Pointe ist jedoch bitter: Offenbar braucht es in manchen Teilen der Kulturbranche länger, eine Filmszene zu korrigieren, als einen Spielfilm zu drehen – einschließlich Director’s

sharedPost.text:
Alternate Shadows had an absolute ball performing *Beyond The Fray*, the wonderfully witty comedy revue by Matthew Fray, at Medway Little Theatre, Rochester.

It was fantastic to see a full house and so many familiar faces. Thank you for filling the theatre with laughter (and for laughing in all the right places... mostly! 😉).

Every sketch and scene was written by Matt, with some pieces co-written by him for both stage and film. His sharp wit, quirky humour and knack for finding the funny in everyday life were on full display once again. Proof that great comedy really does stand the test of time.

We're now waiting to hear how much was raised for AMMF – The Cholangiocarcinoma Charity, helping to fund vital research and raise awareness of this rare cancer. Every ticket, donation and round of applause has helped support a truly worthwhile cause.

A huge thank you to Medway Little Theatre for welcoming us into their wonderful venue, and to everyone who made the evening possible—our cast, backstage crew, front of house, technical team and all the unsung heroes who kept everything running smoothly. Theatre really is a team sport!

And finally, thank you to our brilliant audience. Your laughter was everything we could have asked for.

Matt, wherever you are, we hope you were watching with that trademark grin. You wrote the jokes... we just tried not to ruin them!

***SEEKING A MALE ACTOR & STAGE MANAGER***

True Repertory Theatre seeks an actor and stage manager for its October production of HOLD PLEASE!

HOLD PLEASE is an original play and the 4th that True Repertory Theatre has produced since 2022. It chronicles my personal journey with kidney disease/transplantation, working in call centers and running a theater company.

DETAILS:

ACTOR:

Seeking an actor age 50-65 to play a kidney doctor and kidney donor & other potential roles. This is a non paid acting position. If interested, please email truerepertorytheatre@gmail.com with a headshot and resume. 

STAGE MANAGER:

The stage manager will need to be present for rehearsals, tech week and performances. This is a paid position and compensation will be based on experience. If interested, please email truerepertorytheatre@gmail.com with your resume.

PRODUCTION DETAILS:

REHEARSALS:

August 16-October 8. 

Rehearsals will take place on Tuesday & Thursday evening and Sunday (Time TBD). Two weeks prior to tech week, we will add Monday evenings.

TECH WEEK:

October 11-16

PERFORMANCES:

October 17   8pm
October 18   3pm
October 23   8pm
October 24   3pm & 8pm
October 25   3pm & STRIKE

LOCATION:

All rehearsals and performances will take place at The Beal House, 222 Main St., Kingston, MA. 

Thank you!

items.text:
Henry Travers…. was 66 years old when Hollywood gave him the role that would make him immortal.

For decades Travers worked steadily on stage….appeared in 100+ films…. playing doctors, judges, priests, kindly older gents…

By mid-1940s… he was an aging character actor…..then Frank Capra offered him a role unlike anything he played before in…”A Wonderful Life”/1946….

Many assumed the film would be forgotten. Then in 1970s, the copyright expired and TV stations across the country played the film at Christmas.
His simple reminder..…”No man is a failure who has friends”……became one of the most endearing messages in American film history.

An angel….Clarence…..on a snowy bridge…became one of the most cherished moments in film history.

A beacon of hope…..teaching audiences that every life has infinite worth….

Took Henry Travers 80 years to become an overnight success.

#henrytravers #characteractor #itsawonderfullife #clarencetheangel #jimmystewart

Hi! Casting last minute for tomorrow evening.

Need a doctor for an infomercial in weho!

[Man; 40 to 60 years old; White. Dr. Gideon Void is a slick, charismatic, and wildly popular local “celebrity doctor” known for his flashy late-night infomercials and over-the-top charm. With his polished yuppie aesthetic, million-dollar smile, and smooth-talking salesman energy, he’s the face of cutting-edge memory-erasure procedures. Beneath the gleaming smile and infomercial flair lies something darker — a man who genuinely believes he’s helping people… or is he? This role requires a strong commercial-style performer who can deliver a captivating 1-minute on-camera advertisement for a revolutionary (and slightly sinister) lobotomy-inspired procedure that allows patients to selectively forget painful memories — in this case, an ex-girlfriend.

CASTING CALL- Victoria
Hey everyone! My name is Kalyn Andrea, I’m currently the LP for a proof of concept short filming here in LA. We are having a casting call for one of our supporting characters - Victoria. 

Description: 

Woman; 18 to 27 years old; Eastern European/ White or Mediterranean. Victoria is a young Russian woman desperately trying to escape a dangerous life tied to the criminal underworld. After witnessing a brutal retaliatory mob attack on her friend, she is left deeply traumatized, and forced into hiding. 

Must be able to speak fluent Russian and English. The role requires strong emotional depth, and vulnerability.

Details: 

Compensation: Volunteer, non-paid work (we are a micro budget film sorry!) Credited both in and off screen, as well as IMBD. Meals will be provided. Networking opportunities, we have an amazing crew ready to work on this film! ☺️

Shoot dates: Aug 15,16 and Sept 5,6. Table read most likely Aug 8/9. Rehearsals (1) to happen during week of Aug 9. 

Film location: Pasadena, CA (nearby PCC) 

*must be comfortable wearing sfx makeup (bruises) 

If you’re interested, please PM your headshot, your height, and your link/reel/resume. Once you’ve PM, please comment so we know you’ve reached out! Also, please share to anyone you think may be interested!! 🎞️

Thank you guys so much for your time and consideration, we hope you audition! Thanks 🙂‍↔️

👋🏾 Hello everyone!
I’m Zoe Briggs, a Corporate Presenter, Voice-over Artist and Event Host based in the UK, available for projects nationwide and internationally. I help brands and organisations deliver messages that are clear, engaging and authentic.

🎙️ Services I offer:

• Corporate & commercial voice-over

• On-camera presenting

• Brand films & promotional videos

• Training & e-learning content

• Corporate communications

• Executive interviews

• Conference & event hosting

• Panel moderation

I’ve worked with organisations including Zealous Media, Voxpop and TELUS UK, and I’m always looking to connect with casting directors, producers, agencies and brands who need a professional presenter or voice for their next project. Zoe_Briggs_Corporate_Media_Deck JULY 2026.pdf

If you have an upcoming project, I’d love to connect. Feel free to send me a message—I’d be happy to share my showreel, voice reels and media deck.

Looking forward to connecting with you all! 😊🎬🎙️

I am having a proof of concept film shoot/pilot being shot on the 5th and 6th of August in Derby/ Stoke-On-Trent for my new indie film. We need extras who can join us for a nightclub and other scenes a maximum of 10 in total, to join our cast of 5-10 actors/actresses over 2 days. 

The extras would need to be West Midlands based or willing to travel.

It would be expenses only initially (travel covered locally if required) There would be promo exposure and a possibility for future paid work post this production. 

The film will be entered into a film festival in September and beyond so this would be an excellent opportunity for up and coming or emerging actors/actresses. Any interested people please hit me up and I can answer any further questions as required. Song composers also wanted.

Final Call 🎬 CASTING CALL – OFFIZIELLES Musik Video

Website: www.rickyleroy.com
TikTok: [https://www.tiktok.com/@rickyleroymalle](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.tiktok.com/@rickyleroymalle&sa=D&source=calendar&usd=2&usg=AOvVaw2jeCv9FKLEyaZcY6FNLMSa)
YouTube: [https://www.youtube.com/@RickyLeroymusic](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.youtube.com/@RickyLeroymusic&sa=D&source=calendar&usd=2&usg=AOvVaw02pi-P-M6ss9IIBSxKrmpV)

Für das offizielle Musikvideo zur neuen Party-Single „Titten & Bier“ von Ricky Leroy suchen wir gut gelaunte Menschen, die Lust auf einen sommerlichen Drehtag voller Party-Atmosphäre haben.

Das Projekt:
Es handelt sich umein unabhängiges Low-Budget-Musikvideoprojekt.

Daher können wir leider keinebranchenübliche Gage zahlen. Als Dank für deine Zeit erhältst du eine Aufwandsentschädigung von 75 €, kostenlose Getränke sowie dein persönliches Footage für Showreel oder Social Media.

Wen wir suchen:
Wir suchen Personenab 18 Jahren für eine ausgelassene Poolparty-Szene.

Wichtig: Alle Bewerber*innen müssen mindestens 18 Jahre alt sein. Vorerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – gute Laune und Lust auf einen Drehtag stehen im Vordergrund.

Das erwartet euch:
🏖️ Sommerliche Poolparty-Atmosphäre
🎶 Musik, Tanzen und gute Stimmung
🍺 Kostenlose Getränke
💶 Kostenlose Snacks & Essen Grill

Über den Song:
Mit „Titten & Bier“ liefert Ricky Leroy einen energie geladenen Party-Song im Mallorca- und Ballermann-Stil. Der Titel steht für Sommer, Feiern, gute Freunde und jede Menge gute Laune – mit eingängigen Beats, amerikanischem Akzent und einemAugenzwinkern.

Dresscode:
👙 Bikini
🩱 Badeanzug
🩳 Badehose
😎 Sommerliche Party-Outfits

Drehtag:
📅 15.08.2026
🕙 Anfangszeit 10 Uhr bis zum 20 Uhr 10.08.2026

📍 Der genaue Drehort wird spätestens bis zum 10.08.2026

Bewerbung:
Bitte sende uns perE-Mail:
* ein aktuelles Foto
* deinen Namen
* dein Alter
* deine Handynummer
* optional: dein Instagram- oder TikTok-Profil

E-Mail: diodoublegeerecords@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns aufdeine Bewerbung und darauf, gemeinsam mit dir ein stimmungsvolles Musikvideo zuproduzieren. 🍻☀️
